title: Senior SAP / ABAP Engineer
model: written by hand in a Claude Code session, 2026-10-07

criteria.question: Tell us about your ABAP development on S/4HANA and ECC, and for how long.
criteria.source_quote: At least 6 years of hands-on ABAP development on S/4HANA and ECC (not configuration with some coding attached).
criteria.looks_like: Six or more years writing ABAP on S/4HANA and ECC, not configuration.

criteria.question: What ABAP have you shipped into a customer's production system?
criteria.source_quote: ABAP you've shipped into someone else's production system, with the upgrade cycles, transports, and volume problems that follow.
criteria.looks_like: ABAP shipped into customer systems, through upgrades, transports and volume.

criteria.question: What accounts payable processes have you built or supported in SAP?
criteria.source_quote: Deep AP knowledge: three-way match, Skonto postings, blocked invoices, open item clearing, vendor master, payment runs, duplicate detection.
criteria.looks_like: Three-way match, Skonto, blocked invoices, open item clearing, vendor master, payment runs, duplicate detection.

criteria.question: Which modern ABAP do you use: CDS, OO ABAP, ABAP Unit, RAP?
criteria.source_quote: Strong modern ABAP: CDS views, OO ABAP, ABAP Unit, RAP, and an instinct for upgrade-safe, namespace-clean code.
criteria.looks_like: CDS views, OO ABAP, ABAP Unit, RAP, upgrade-safe code in a namespace.

criteria.question: How have third-party systems integrated with your S/4HANA or ECC systems?
criteria.source_quote: Fluency in how third-party systems integrate with S/4HANA and ECC (OData, RFC, IDoc), including where the two data models diverge.
criteria.looks_like: OData, RFC, IDoc integrations with S/4HANA and ECC.

criteria.question: Tell us about a scope or risk call you made and how you explained it.
criteria.source_quote: Judgment about scope and risk, and the ability to explain that call to engineers and executives alike.
criteria.looks_like: A scope or risk decision explained to engineers and executives.

criteria.question: Where do you see enterprise systems and AI meeting?
criteria.source_quote: Curiosity beyond the SAP world, and energy for where enterprise systems and AI meet.
criteria.looks_like: Interest in AI applied to enterprise systems.

criteria.question: How do you work with finance people and engineers, in English?
criteria.source_quote: Clear communication with both engineers and finance people, in English; Spanish or German is a strong plus.
criteria.looks_like: Clear English with engineers and finance teams; Spanish or German.

criteria.question: How do you use AI in your ABAP development, testing and analysis?
criteria.source_quote: Using AI to leverage ADT services to speed up the development, deployment, testing and analysis
criteria.looks_like: AI with ADT for development, deployment, testing, analysis; custom test programs.

criteria.question: What accounts receivable processes do you know?
criteria.source_quote: Accounts receivable knowledge alongside the AP side: customer master, incoming payments and cash application, dunning, credit management, and what drives DSO.
criteria.looks_like: Customer master, incoming payments, cash application, dunning, credit management, DSO.

criteria.question: Have you taken an add-on through SAP certification?
criteria.source_quote: Experience taking an add-on through SAP certification (ICC), or working inside a registered namespace as a partner.
criteria.looks_like: An add-on certified by SAP (ICC), or partner work in a registered namespace.

criteria.question: Have you used SAP Joule?
criteria.looks_like: Hands-on use of SAP Joule, or a view on it.

criteria.question: Have you worked with SAP BTP?
criteria.source_quote: SAP BTP exposure (extensions, the API layer, or GCP-hosted environments).
criteria.looks_like: BTP extensions, its API layer, or GCP-hosted environments.

criteria.question: Have you worked on AP automation or e-invoicing?
criteria.source_quote: Experience with AP automation, e-invoicing, or procure-to-pay workflows.

criteria.question: Have you worked in fintech or accounting tech?
criteria.source_quote: Background in fintech, accounting tech, or a regulated environment.
criteria.looks_like: Fintech, accounting technology, or a regulated environment.

criteria.question: How would you structure and release an ABAP add-on?
criteria.source_quote: Architectural ownership of our ABAP add-on in its registered namespace
criteria.looks_like: Structure, release and upgrade safety of an add-on.

criteria.question: How do you turn FI/CO rules into code?
criteria.looks_like: Posting logic, payment terms, open items, account determination, tax codes.
